Position Details:
Infrastructure engineer
Dallas, TX
12 months 


Job Description- SUMMARY: 
•    Responsible for all aspects of Microsoft stack based Infrastructure services. This includes research, design, test, and deploy technologies being implemented by the desktop organization.
•    Majority of the focus will be on technologies that utilize a desktop OS. 
PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 
•    Research, design, deploy, and test Windows Operating Systems 
•    Create, update, test and deploy software packages. 
•    Perform lifecycle management for operating systems as well as applications using the Microsoft System Center suite of products (maintain hotfixes, service packs, software deployments) 
•    Familiarity with Microsoft System Center, scripting, PowerShell and other automation processes and solutions 
•    Familiarity with virtualization technologies 
•    Perform as tier three\four level support engineer to troubleshoot and resolve complex enterprise level issues 
SECONDARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 
•    Responds to the needs and questions of users concerning their access of resources on the network 
•    Develops and adheres to enterprise standards 
•    Provides planning and technical support for company installations 
•    Provide assistance to other support groups as necessary 
•    Assists in the selection and recommendation of standardized equipment selection 
•    Stays abreast of new technologies as it applies to business needs 
•    Performs other duties as assigned 
QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: 
•    To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each primary and secondary duties defined above. 
•    3+ years of experience in the field as a Systems Engineer. 
•    An MCSE certification is a plus. 
SPECIALIZED SKILLS: 
•    Ability to diagnose and solve complex system and enterprise level problems 
•    Create and maintain architecture, design and installation documentation 
•    Experience with IT mergers is a plus 
•    Effectively communicate with peers and management
